name: sairou（犀楼）
description: sairou 原生日文形态键（ウィンク２、ジト目、怒まゆ左、視線上 等）。标了 guessed 的需要游戏实测。
description_en: sairou's native Japanese shape keys (ウィンク２, ジト目, 怒まゆ左, 視線上, ...). Mappings marked guessed need testing in game.

channels.name: 上
channels.note: 眉毛上移；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 8.2mm（sairou）。左右合一的“上”，整条眉毛上移。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browRaise.L / browRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow up; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 8.2 mm (sairou). The combined "上" key, the whole brow up. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browRaise.L / browRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: まゆ下左
channels.note: 眉毛下压（左侧）。最大位移 14.9mm（sairou）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (left). Max displacement 14.9 mm (sairou). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.L, the larger wins

channels.name: まゆ下右
channels.note: 眉毛下压（右侧）。最大位移 14.9mm（sairou）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browLower.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Brow down (right). Max displacement 14.9 mm (sairou). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browLower.R, the larger wins

channels.name: 困りまゆ左
channels.note: 眉头上提（左侧）。最大位移 10.4mm（sairou）。困りまゆ：眉头微升、眉尾下垂，并向内收
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (left). Max displacement 10.4 mm (sairou). 困りまゆ: inner brow slightly up, outer brow down, drawn inward

channels.name: 困りまゆ右
channels.note: 眉头上提（右侧）。最大位移 10.4mm（sairou）。困りまゆ：眉头微升、眉尾下垂，并向内收
channels.note_en: Inner brow up (right). Max displacement 10.4 mm (sairou). 困りまゆ: inner brow slightly up, outer brow down, drawn inward

channels.name: 怒まゆ左
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（左侧）。最大位移 6.6mm（sairou）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (left). Max displacement 6.6 mm (sairou). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.L, the larger wins

channels.name: 怒まゆ右
channels.note: 眉头下压（皱眉）（右侧）。最大位移 6.6mm（sairou）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 browInnerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Inner brow down (frown) (right). Max displacement 6.6 mm (sairou). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal browInnerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: ウィンク２
channels.note: 闭眼（左侧）。最大位移 16.7mm（sairou）。MMD 式单眼闭眼键：ウィンク２ 是角色左眼（Blender 已确认）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.L，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (left). Max displacement 16.7 mm (sairou). MMD-style one-eye close key: ウィンク２ is the character's left eye (confirmed in Blender). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.L, the larger wins

channels.name: ウィンク２右
channels.note: 闭眼（右侧）。最大位移 16.7mm（sairou）。MMD 式单眼闭眼键：ウィンク２ 是角色左眼（Blender 已确认）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 eyeClose.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Eye closed (right). Max displacement 16.7 mm (sairou). MMD-style one-eye close key: ウィンク２ is the character's left eye (confirmed in Blender). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal eyeClose.R, the larger wins

channels.name: ジト目
channels.note: 上眼睑下降、眼裂缩小；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 5.4mm（sairou）
channels.note_en: Upper lid lowers, eye narrows; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 5.4 mm (sairou)

channels.name: まぶた上げ左
channels.note: 睁大眼（左侧）。最大位移 2.3mm（sairou）
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (left). Max displacement 2.3 mm (sairou)

channels.name: まぶた上げ右
channels.note: 睁大眼（右侧）。最大位移 2.3mm（sairou）
channels.note_en: Eye wide open (right). Max displacement 2.3 mm (sairou)

channels.name: ほほ上げ
channels.note: 下眼睑上提（笑眼下睑分量）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 4.5mm（sairou）。ほほ上げ：脸颊和下眼睑一起上提。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 cheekRaise.L / cheekRaise.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Lower lid raised (the lower-lid part of a smiling eye); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 4.5 mm (sairou). ほほ上げ: cheeks and lower lids rise together. Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal cheekRaise.L / cheekRaise.R, the larger wins

channels.name: あ
channels.note: 张嘴。最大位移 12.4mm（sairou）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 jawDrop，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth open. Max displacement 12.4 mm (sairou). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal jawDrop, the larger wins

channels.name: う
channels.note: u 口型（嘴唇收拢）；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 12.7mm（sairou）
channels.note_en: "u" mouth shape (lips rounded); one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 12.7 mm (sairou)

channels.name: 口角上げ
channels.note: 嘴角上扬；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 2.3mm（sairou）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerUp.L / mouthCornerUp.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner up; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 2.3 mm (sairou). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerUp.L / mouthCornerUp.R, the larger wins

channels.name: 口角下げ
channels.note: 嘴角下垂；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 1.4mm（sairou）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerDown.L / mouthCornerDown.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner down; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 1.4 mm (sairou). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerDown.L / mouthCornerDown.R, the larger wins

channels.name: 口横広げ
channels.note: 嘴角向外、嘴变宽；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 2.6mm（sairou）。游戏动作表情由面部骨骼驱动：同时读骨骼信号 mouthCornerOut.L / mouthCornerOut.R，取较大者
channels.note_en: Mouth corner out, mouth wider; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 2.6 mm (sairou). Gameplay emotes move the face bones: also reads the bone signal mouthCornerOut.L / mouthCornerOut.R, the larger wins

channels.name: すぼめ
channels.note: 嘴角向内、嘴变窄；左右合一的键，左右信号各取一半。最大位移 7.2mm（sairou）。すぼめ：嘴角向内收拢
channels.note_en: Mouth corner in, mouth narrower; one key for both sides, half of each side's signal. Max displacement 7.2 mm (sairou). すぼめ: mouth corners draw inward

channels.name: 口上
channels.note: 嘴整体上移。最大位移 3.3mm（sairou）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth up. Max displacement 3.3 mm (sairou)

channels.name: 口下
channels.note: 嘴整体下移。最大位移 4.6mm（sairou）
channels.note_en: Whole mouth down. Max displacement 4.6 mm (sairou)

channels.name: 視線上
channels.note: 虹膜上移。最大位移 5.6mm（sairou）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris up. Max displacement 5.6 mm (sairou). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: 視線下
channels.note: 虹膜下移。最大位移 7.5mm（sairou）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris down. Max displacement 7.5 mm (sairou). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: 視線左
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色左侧。最大位移 8.2mm（sairou）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's left. Max displacement 8.2 mm (sairou). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.

channels.name: 視線右
channels.note: 虹膜移向角色右侧。最大位移 8.2mm（sairou）。视线方向按 Shinano 游戏实测换算：虹膜移向角色自身左侧(+X) 对应 yaw +1。
channels.note_en: Iris to the character's right. Max displacement 8.2 mm (sairou). Gaze direction converted as measured in game on Shinano: iris toward the character's own left (+X) = yaw +1.
